name: 指定した時刻の営業条件を調整する検索行
prompt:
Create one compact Japanese search-condition row as a standalone horizontal UI component on a clean white canvas, matching the supplied source crop proportions (1080:162, about 6.67:1).

Reference priority:
1) The original row crop controls the exact geometry, clock icon, text alignment, right-side adjustment icon, whitespace and bottom divider.
2) The Japanese preview controls the exact localized copy and Lighthouse green accent.

Include only one row: a thin outlined clock icon at the far left; exact Japanese text “10:55に営業している場所” in a clear Japanese sans-serif; a compact sliders/adjustments icon at the far right; and a thin pale-gray divider along the bottom edge. Use the preview's green for the clock and label, with the darker active accent on “10:55” if needed to match the source emphasis; use charcoal for the sliders icon. Preserve the source spacing and vertical centering. Use a Meiryo-style Regular 14/20 Japanese face, with only the time emphasis in Semibold.

Keep the composition extremely wide and short, with modest white space above and below the row. Do not add a page heading, search field, map, cards, phone frame, status bar, extra labels, background decorations or watermark.
